candidate_surface: cross-framework multi-agent planning/scheduling benchmark with inter-agent dependencies, resource constraints and dynamic disruptions
candidate_metric_definition: Post-hoc schedule consistency: temporal dependency violations and resource-capacity violations are converted into consistency percentages. It is not a treatment/control measure of an interaction-generated disturbance being attenuated through a native S2 relation.
direct_s2_gate_failures: coordination_effectiveness scores end-state temporal/resource consistency rather than an explicit disturbance-to-attenuation treatment

frameworks.blocking_reason: The benchmark does not isolate a direct disturbance-to-attenuation result attributable to the canonical first-party S2 boundary.

Canonical LangGraph does not establish S2 at the reviewed runtime boundary; benchmark-authored graphs cannot donate S2 to that canonical system.

non_claim: REALM-Bench is useful public multi-agent planning evidence, but coordination vocabulary, dynamic disruption and schedule-consistency metrics do not by themselves establish a direct S2 benchmark cell. The reviewed comparison contains only one canonical S2 system and does not create a direct family, observation, canonical matched cell, or primary baseline.
